title: journal_event
description: One line in the journal: something that happened to a person's place in a class, or to a request's placement, with who did it and when (created_by, created_at). Append-only: an entry is written by the server in the same step as the change it records, and is never edited or deleted. The journal is provenance, not truth: whether a request is assigned is read from the attendance records, never from the journal. Rules the schema cannot express: entries are written only by the server; nothing here can be updated or soft deleted through the endpoints; erasing a person removes what describes the entry and leaves an anonymous tombstone.
x_retention: Kept. When the individual is erased the entry is soft deleted and everything that describes it is removed, leaving an anonymous tombstone. (A written policy only; the erase code does it.)

event_type.description: What happened: placed (a person was put in a class), status_changed (their status changed), removed (the entry was taken out as a mistake), class_cancelled (the class was cancelled, so the person was cancelled), class_removed (the class was deleted, so the person was cancelled) or request_unassigned (the request has no active placement left and is waiting to be placed again). Required.

request_id.description: The registration request this concerns, when there is one. Optional. Not checked.

scheduled_class_id.description: The class this concerns. Optional. Not checked.

individual_id.description: The person this concerns. Optional. Not checked. Repointed when people are merged.

attendance_id.description: The attendance record this concerns. Optional. Not checked.

role.description: The person's role in the class at the time: student, primary_instructor or instructor. Optional.

from_status.description: The attendance status before the change. Optional.

to_status.description: The attendance status after the change. Optional.

note.description: Free text about the event, up to 2000 characters. Personal data. Optional.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. A deleted link is a mistake corrected, not a relationship that ended. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
